best_idea: Skill points accrue at a rate set by two attributes (primary plus half the secondary, per minute), and the server stores an end time computed from the rate instead of ticking progress.
decision_why: The rate-from-attributes and stored end time give Frankendom an offline progression queue for non-combat skills without a tick loop. Adapt: do not use it for in-fight stats; fix integer division (level inverse, minute truncation) and the zero-rate case.
acceptance: A player queues a 100 SP skill at 27 SP per minute and sees 4 minutes (not 3); a server test asserts 1415 SP at rank 1 reports level 2 and a skill at its target returns end time 0.
